gaps.sentence: The thief was sent to ___ prison for three years.
gaps.explanation: 'Sent to prison' — the institution, no article; 'the prison' would mean the building.

gaps.sentence: It's ___ one-way street, so you can't turn left here.
gaps.explanation: 'One' starts with /w/, a consonant sound, so 'a one-way street'.

gaps.sentence: We visited ___ Louvre on our last morning in Paris.
gaps.explanation: Most famous buildings and monuments take 'the': the Louvre, the Eiffel Tower.
'Have an eye for something' — fixed idiom with 'an'.

gaps.sentence: She gets up at six and watches ___ morning news.
gaps.explanation: 'The morning news' — a specific known broadcast, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best film of the decade by common consent.
We're going to ___ Algarve for a fortnight in June.
gaps.explanation: Region names often take the: the Algarve, the Riviera.

gaps.sentence: ___ Himalayas are among the youngest mountains on Earth.
gaps.explanation: Ranges like 'the Himalayas' take 'the'; single peaks take no article.
